explication: Kuni is a Telegram-based LLM character: incoming Telegram activity is formatted as context and notifications, processed by worker-driven chat logic and an OpenAI-compatible model, then acted on through Telegram tools. Its documented capabilities also include persistent diary/RAG memory and sleep consolidation, working memory, media handling, speech, web search, and an optional LLM proxy. The supplied excerpts establish the main entry point and selected interfaces; several capability branches are documented or indexed but their detailed runtime wiring was not sampled.
